task.description: Independently re-derive and verify all 11 REQ-198 acceptance criteria (docs/requirements.yaml, id REQ-198) against the actual shipped code and tests on branch feature/WF02-REQ198-20260830 -- do not trust any prior agent's PASS claim, re-run the suite and re-check the code yourself. In particular: confirm all 8 builtins (length, lower, upper, trim, contains, startsWith, endsWith, coalesce) evaluate correctly with concrete expected values; confirm wrong-name and wrong-arity calls are rejected as structured parse errors; confirm null propagation matches R-Co exactly (length(null)->null, contains(null,"x")->null, coalesce(null,null,3)->3); confirm non-string arguments to string functions error rather than coerce; confirm the moduledoc states and tests the ASCII-vs-Unicode case-conversion decision; confirm now()/date_add/date_diff are NOT added and now() is rejected; confirm expr.ex's purity grep still returns zero matches; confirm @unsupported_call_markers still rejects everything it rejected before, via a test iterating the full marker list; confirm EE-05's catch-false contract holds for wrong-arity builtin calls through evaluate_condition/2; confirm mix test and mix compile --warnings-as-errors both pass, with the 2 known pre-existing rustc-absent CheckToolchainTest failures being the only acceptable exceptions (name them explicitly, do not silently wave off any other failure).
acceptance_criteria: each of the eight builtins evaluates correctly, asserted by at least one test per function with a concrete expected value -- eight tests minimum
a call to a name outside the whitelist, such as frobnicate(1), is rejected as a parse error rather than evaluating or raising, and the rejection carries REQ-197's structured error

wrong arity is rejected for a fixed-arity function: length() with zero arguments and length(a, b) with two are both errors, and coalesce() with zero arguments is an error while coalesce(a) with one is valid
null propagation matches R-Co: length(null) yields null, contains(null, "x") yields null, and coalesce(null, null, 3) yields 3 -- three explicit tests
a non-string argument to a string function, such as length(42), is an error rather than a coerced result
the case-conversion decision is stated in the moduledoc -- ASCII-only matching R-Co, or full Unicode -- and a test asserts the chosen behaviour on a non-ASCII input
none of now(), date_add or date_diff is added, and a test asserts an expression calling now() is rejected rather than evaluated
expr.ex's documented purity grep still returns ZERO matches after this change, quoted in the PR

every construct @unsupported_call_markers rejected before this requirement is still rejected after it, asserted by a test iterating the marker list -- adding the eight builtins did not weaken the CEL rejection
EE-05's catch-false contract holds: a gateway condition calling a builtin with wrong arity still yields false from evaluate_condition/2 rather than raising
mix test and mix compile --warnings-as-errors both pass with real output quoted
